notes: Nill Download Manager 2.0.1 — two fixes from real-world use. The update check now fetches its feed from github.com itself, with the previous address kept as a fallback, so update popups and Check for Update keep working on networks where that address times out. And the browser download card now opens at the same measured size as IDM's download dialog — full-width rows, proper buttons — on Windows and Linux alike.
